## Common WHERE Filters

| Filter Column | Typical Values | Context |
|---------------|----------------|---------|
| `grass_date` | `DATE'${run_date}'`, `'2026-05-07'` | 日期分区，必选 |
| `grass_region` | `'ID'`, `'BR'`, `'SG'` 等 8 区 | 地域分区，可选 |
| `type` | `3` (campaign 粒度) | 下游最常用 campaign 粒度 |
| `status` | `1` (预算修改), `2` (troi修改), `4` (计划状态异常) | 按状态分类过滤 |
| `operation` | `'INDEX'`, `'DELETE'` | 索引操作类型 |

常见组合：

```sql
-- 下游 dws_seller_operation 读取 campaign 粒度
WHERE grass_date = DATE'${run_date}'
  AND type = 3
  AND grass_region = '${region}'

-- 手动查询特定状态
WHERE grass_date = '2026-05-07'
  AND grass_region = 'BR'
  AND type = 3
  AND status IN (1, 2)

-- 按 ID 查询
WHERE grass_date = '2025-12-30'
  AND id = 127663957
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 按 campaign 统计暂停/停止次数
COUNT(CASE WHEN operation = 'DELETE' AND status = 4 AND reason LIKE '%ADS_PAUSED%' THEN 1 END) AS campaign_pause_cnt
COUNT(CASE WHEN operation = 'DELETE' AND status = 4 AND reason LIKE '%ADS_CLOSED%' THEN 1 END) AS campaign_stop_cnt

-- 提取 reason 中的数值用于聚合
CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'old_value=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS old_val
CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'new_value=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS new_val
CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'old_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS old_budget
CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'new_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS new_budget

-- 方向判断（first vs last of the day）
MIN_BY(old_val, timestamp) AS first_troi
MAX_BY(new_val, timestamp) AS last_troi
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 下游 dws_seller_operation — 提取 campaign 级操作日志特征

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT id AS campaign_id, grass_region, operation, status, reason, timestamp
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dwd_ads_index_status_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE'${run_date}'
      AND type = 3
      AND grass_region = '${region}'
),
pause_stop AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id, grass_region,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN operation = 'DELETE' AND status = 4 AND reason LIKE '%ADS_PAUSED%' THEN 1 END) AS campaign_pause_cnt,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN operation = 'DELETE' AND status = 4 AND reason LIKE '%ADS_CLOSED%' THEN 1 END) AS campaign_stop_cnt
    FROM base
    GROUP BY campaign_id, grass_region
),
troi_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id, grass_region, timestamp,
        CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'old_value=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS old_val,
        CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'new_value=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS new_val
    FROM base
    WHERE operation = 'INDEX' AND status = 2
),
budget_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id, grass_region, timestamp,
        CASE WHEN CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'old_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) = 0
             THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'old_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)
        END AS old_val,
        CASE WHEN CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'new_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) = 0
             THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(regexp_extract(reason, 'new_budget=([0-9.E+]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)
        END AS new_val
    FROM base
    WHERE operation = 'INDEX' AND status = 1
)
SELECT ... FROM campaign_dim cd
LEFT JOIN pause_stop     p  ON cd.campaign_id = p.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN troi_counts    t  ON cd.campaign_id = t.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN budget_counts  b  ON cd.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN troi_direction td ON cd.campaign_id = td.campaign_id
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### 生产 Workflow

| 属性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Workflow 路径 | `mkplpaidads_search_ads/workflows/ads_algo/ads_diagnosis/ads_index_status_daily/` |
| 调度频率 | Daily（per-region 分区覆写） |
| 写入方式 | DROP PARTITION + `insertInto(overwrite=True)` |
| 执行引擎 | PySpark |
| 分区覆写模式 | `spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode=dynamic` |

### 上游表

| 上游表 | 用途 | JOIN 关系 |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live` | 获取 ads_id → campaign_id/shop_id/item_id 映射 | LEFT JOIN on ads_id, grass_date, grass_region |
| `mp_paidads.ods_shopee_paidads_index_log` | 索引日志（INDEX/DELETE 操作） | 主数据源 |
| `mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live` | campaign 审核事件（预算修改/TROI修改） | 展开到 ads 粒度后 UNION |
| `mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log` | 流量控制异常（anti_fraud/deboost） | 按 ads_id 去重后 UNION |

### 数据处理逻辑

1. index_log 去重：按 `(ads_id, grass_date, grass_region)` 按 timestamp 排序，只保留 operation 变化点
2. reason → status 映射：通过 LIKE 匹配 reason 文本分类为 status 0-8
3. campaign_audit 展开：audit_event=8(预算修改) 和 50(TROI修改) 通过 INNER JOIN dim_advertise 展开到 ads 粒度
4. 流量控制：从 traffic_control struct 提取 anti_fraud_block 和 deboost 概率
5. 多粒度输出：UNION 四种粒度 (ads/item/campaign/shop)，每种粒度用不同 status 子集
6. timestamp 统一为秒级（自动检测秒/毫秒/微秒），添加 hour 列
